        export HOME="$__ta_default_home"
    fi
    if [ "$__ta_restore_cwd_failed" = 1 ]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'ShellStateUnavailable: 已保存工作目录无法恢复，本次命令未执行。' >&2
        builtin cd -- "$__ta_initial_cwd" || exit 1
        printf '后续命令将从工作区 %s 开始。沙箱临时文件只在单次调用内保留；请在同一次调用中创建并使用临时副本。\n' "$PWD" >&2
        false
        
__ta_rc=$?
if PWD=$(builtin pwd); then
{ printf '__ta_home_version=1\ncd %q\n' "$PWD"; export -p; } > "$__ta_state.tmp" 2>/dev/null && mv "$__ta_state.tmp" "$__ta_state"
printf '%s\n' "$PWD" > '/home/rimuru/Projects/Code/for_fun/TeamAgents/review/eval/r2-p6/runs/2026-09-24-pilot/state/split-deliverable.B.1/shell/host'/cwd 2>/dev/null
fi
exit $__ta_rc

    fi
fi
